focus: Map the nine values pushed at the Rome2.exe call to entry_point to caller variables and callee argument positions. Explain the apparent eight-parameter callee versus nine pushed values without guessing a purpose for an unused value.

Recover the launcher reservation-mode algorithm and conservatively identify the meanings and widths of entry arguments 4 through 7. Decide what is obsolete on x64 and what must be represented as guest32 state.

Prove how the launcher consumes entry_point's return value, when it starts another process, and what the bootstrap return value currently means. Propose a falsifiable x64 host test for this contract without spawning a process.

Audit calling convention, stack cleanup, WinMain-style inputs, and the extra pushed argument at the original call site. State only what can be proven and define the safest internal x64 adapter signature.

Recover the exact high-level phase order in entry_point, including early return, exception-handler branch, engine-dispatch call, state setters, COM cleanup, and final byte result. Mark every side-effect boundary.
Trace each original entry argument to every read, write, dereference, and downstream call. Identify which current bootstrap parameter names are proven, inferred, or misleading.
Isolate the COM/Game Explorer preflight behavior and its early-return rule. Design a dependency seam and deterministic tests; do not propose calling real Game Explorer or modifying the machine.
Audit the exact comparison against -no_exception_handler and the two downstream branches. Determine which behavior is pure enough for the first executable startup checkpoint and which remains unsafe.
Adjudicate decomp_fn_100d6900 as a first native startup helper using canonical source and pinned bytes B0 01 C3. Specify exact C semantics, return width, linkage boundary, and negative tests.
Adjudicate the one-byte startup flag setter at 0x101136d0, pinned bytes 8A442404 A28E3D9F11 C3. Design explicit state ownership and tests without introducing a process-global legacy address.

Adjudicate the four-byte callback-cell setter at 0x101150f0, pinned bytes 8B442404 A35C3F9F11 C3. Decide whether the port should store a guest address, a typed host callback, or neither at this milestone, and justify with ABI evidence.

Audit the one-byte RET body at 0x100d6560 and its many export aliases. Explain why its recovered use as a callback does or does not permit a native typed no-op implementation without claiming the legacy C++ export ABIs.

Derive the smallest explicit startup-state capsule needed for offsets 0x38, 0x58, 0x5c, 0x60, and 0x64 used by entry_point. Preserve original cell widths and reject any unproven surrounding object layout.
Audit the entry_point VirtualFree path through the argument-5 cell. Define a safe x64 representation and explain whether freeing launcher-created reservations belongs in the first checkpoint.

Specify the exact observed command-line comparison semantics, including null handling uncertainty and full-string versus token behavior. Propose a pure port helper and table-driven tests that do not over-generalize it.

Compare two bounded checkpoints: a diagnostic DLL export for the already-proven 0x1093c450 to 0x100e81a0 guest32 chain, and a static pure selector for the 0x100edecc to 0x100edf05 exception-handler branch. Select or order them using execution value, semantic progress, ABI risk, and testability.
Propose a versioned diagnostic ABI for reporting startup checkpoint phases and results without polluting the eventual 1-522 legacy export contract. Include compatibility and removal strategy.

Falsify the proposal to call or mechanically compile the full original entry_point now. Enumerate concrete corruption/crash modes from pointer width, CRT, SEH, globals, dependencies, and launcher reservations, each tied to evidence.

Design independent acceptance oracles for both candidate checkpoints: original-byte provenance, canonical hashes, pure behavioral tests, x64 binary checks, export containment, and negative cases. Identify what candidate-owned tests must not be trusted as the oracle.

Rank the candidate next steps using a decision matrix: diagnostic DLL bridge for the proven guest32 chain, pure entry preflight selector, launcher contract lock, 100d6900, 101136d0, 101150f0/100d6560, COM preflight, full entry_point, or full exports. Select an ordering and list hard rejection gates.
